title: Anytime-valid martingale stopping and conformal risk control
claim_boundary: Source-verified specification and granular execution playbook only; anytime-valid martingale stopping and conformal calibration on sealed benchmarks remain open implementation gates. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

assertions.statement: Pluggable active-learning ranking worker interface with strict separation between observed training labels and sealed holdout pools
open_gates: Define StoppingConfig, MartingaleStep, and StoppingCertificate contracts in crates/searchright-contracts/src/screening.rs.
Implement anytime-valid hypergeometric betting martingale and Ville's inequality e-value wealth trajectory evaluator in crates/searchright-ranking/src/lib.rs.
Implement conformal risk-controlling threshold calibration bounding false-negative screening loss in crates/searchright-ranking/src/lib.rs.
Integrate martingale stopping certificates and strict holdout-leakage guards into sealed SYNERGY/CLEF TAR benchmark evaluation in crates/searchright-bench/src/lib.rs.
assertions.permitted_claim: Scaffolding exists; behaviour is not claimed.
